main_text.p: stinet ab iis quæ Deus fieri vetat: qui amat, facit ea quæ fieri mandavit. Vnde dicunt, Qui colit ex amore, stabilit præcepta affirmativa: qui verò ex timore colit aut operatur (Nam est עובר in Ebraeo) stabilit præcepta negativa. Vide comment. super Aboth fol. 9. pag. 2.
main_text.head: CAP. 23.
Seraríj errores aliquot.
main_text.p: 117Septem inquit, pag. 13. Pharisæorum ordines aut classes faciunt Thalmudici tractatu Sotah. cap. 3. fol. 22. qui meri tamen potius hypocritæ sunt, nimirum Pharisæus Schichmi, Nikphar, Cizai, Medoukia, Machobathi, Veefcheneb, Mehajebah, Mirah. In his verbis quàm multi errores. Pudet me Scrarii: tædet verborum. Ordines dicit aut classes genera hominum. Quid Thalmudici? Septem, inquiunt, Pharisæi sunt, hoc est genera Pharisæorum; non classes, non ordines. Neque enim patres hypocritæ classem diversam constituunt ab iis qui sycophantæ sunt. Neque hypocrita dici recte potest Pharisæus amoris, qualis fuit Abraham: aut timoris, qualis fuit Iob. Pharisæum appello hominem sanctum ac pium. Iam verò mendum latet in Nikphar pro Nikphai vel potius Nikphi. Tum etiam Machobathi scribi debet divisim Mah chobathi, & deleri comma quod proxime sequitur, legique Vaecese. Nam in Ebraeo ואשה, nisi mavelis Vaasane, id est, ואשה & mutabo. Nam Veefchne, & discam, Id est ואשה. Mah chobathi potest reddi, quodnam est peccatum meum? חובה proprie debitum, ὀφείλημα. In Mehajebah etiam vitium est, & in Mira. Nam legendum Meahabah & mi jraa, id est, מאהבה & מיראה. Subintelligitur autem Pharisæus. Sed hæc omnia Serarius non intelle-

page.notes: Marginal numbers 117 and 118 at left are page references of the other edition. The Hebrew words in the text are copied as far as legible; the vowel points and exact letter forms in the Hebrew phrases, and the word "Veefcheneb", are doubtful. The final word of the page "intelle-" continues on the next page. The catchword "tellē" is doubtful and is printed at the right foot.
